---
name: improve-text
description: A skill that enhances the quality of text by improving grammar, clarity, and style. It can also provide suggestions for rephrasing sentences to make them more concise or impactful.
---

- Keep the tone and style of the original text while making improvements.
- Keep the meaning and intent of the original text intact while enhancing its readability and flow.
- Correct grammar and spelling errors in the text.
- Improve sentence structure and word choice to make the text more engaging and effective.
- If any part of the text is unclear or ambiguous, provide suggestions for clarification while maintaining the original intent.
